Class CodecSerializer<T>

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.codec.kafka.CodecSerializer<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the value type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable, org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.Serializer<T>
public final class CodecSerializer<T> extends Object implements org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.Serializer<T>
Adapts a Codec to Kafka's Serializer. The topic is ignored — a codec does not vary by topic — and null serializes to null, Kafka's tombstone, through Codec.nullSafe(). Everything else, including any exception the codec throws, passes through unchanged.

Kafka's reflective, no-arg configuration path (value.serializer=...) cannot construct this class; hand instances to the producer or ProducerFactory directly.
